The two Image extensions in Shared/Core/Sources/Core/Models and Services/ImageCompatability.swift are likely split by platform-conditional compilation (e.g., #if canImport(UIKit) / #if canImport(AppKit)), which is a standard Swift pattern for cross-platform image compatibility. The two CGImage extensions in Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkServiceTests.swift serve test-fixture purposes within the Artwork package. Because the participating types are structurally distinct domain concepts (Image vs. CGImage) and the extensions carry no fields (fields_or_signature is empty for all members), the shared_field_count of 1 provides insufficient evidence of meaningful duplication to justify extraction or consolidation.
